name: Entropic risk measure ρ_θ(X)=(1/θ)log E[e^{−θX}]: convexity, cash-invariance, Gaussian form −μ+(θ/2)σ²
description: Entropic risk measure ρ_θ(X) = θ⁻¹ log E[e^{-θX}]: cash-invariance, convexity, monotonicity, and the Gaussian closed form -μ + (θ/2)σ².

code.lean:
import MathFin.RiskMeasures.Entropic

open MathFin

/-- Entropic risk measure ρ_θ(X) = θ⁻¹ log E[e^{-θX}]: cash-invariance, convexity, monotonicity, and the Gaussian closed form -μ + (θ/2)σ². -/
theorem mf_riskmeasures_entropic {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ) {X Y : Ω → ℝ}
    (hX : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (-θ * X ω)) P)
    (hY : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (-θ * Y ω)) P) :
    (∀ c : ℝ, entropicRisk θ (fun ω => X ω + c) P = entropicRisk θ X P - c) ∧
    (∀ l : ℝ, l ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
      entropicRisk θ (fun ω => l * X ω + (1 - l) * Y ω) P ≤
        l * entropicRisk θ X P + (1 - l) * entropicRisk θ Y P) ∧
    (X ≤ᵐ[P] Y → entropicRisk θ Y P ≤ entropicRisk θ X P) ∧
    (∀ (μ σ : ℝ), 0 ≤ σ → ∀ v : ℝ≥0, (v : ℝ) = σ ^ 2 →
      Measure.map X P = gaussianReal μ v →
      entropicRisk θ X P = entropicRiskGaussian μ σ θ) :=
  MathFin.entropicRisk_properties P hθ hX hY
